historical_seed.member_retention: every exact original member, independently copied; immutable original manifest retained inside image

release_retention: retain each admitted immutable raw revision independently; no numerical merge or provider priority invented
weekly: retain all selected verified complete original releases; no new financial/shareholder use qualification inferred

intraday.role: retained raw/source-evidence only; intraday qualification is outside required current daily purpose
intraday.absence_scope: not found in selected local inventory and queried exact existing CN01/Hermes release paths; not a global non-existence claim

nontrading_events: retain weekend/holiday observations and true acquisition, allow late observations for earlier business dates

time_rules.build_time: actual UTC separate from business cutoff
time_rules.future_reference_or_interval_end: retain original governed reference/interval values; do not truncate to cutoff
time_rules.September_cutoff: no October business observation release admitted

scope_boundaries: no P3/P5/P6 admission or policy relaxation
ODS retains original raw bytes, does not masquerade curated DWD as raw
complete package integrity is not unconditional downstream data qualification

physical_contract.hashes: full SHA256 for every physical member; manifest/content/READY binding
physical_contract.checks: native schema/footer census and SQLite integrity; preserve originally qualified unchanged source semantics by exact bytes
physical_contract.cold_acceptance: two physical ownership copies, two new-process source/network-denied scans; disposable missing/corrupt negative tests; READY last

publication: immutable source seed under explicit successor contract; legacy CURRENT/config is not silently rewritten
original_current_policy: July policy remains frozen. This successor current-daily-purpose contract does not establish complete-intraday qualification.
runtime_binding: The immutable job contract adds exact source admission records and the tracked policy SHA256 after fresh complete physical assessment; no inferred source or revision is admitted.
